title: Independent native workload start constraints v1
description: Closed canonical sorted compact ASCII JSON, no LF, at most 32768 original bytes and nesting depth 6. Ed25519 signs payload schema ASCII, one NUL, then canonical ASCII payload bytes. Shape validation is not signature admission, protected token possession, host/native-proof ownership, journal claim, actual containment or a start permit. The source-private owner must independently join genuine retained originals and the existing OriginalClock; stop/cleanup projections never renew that clock.

signature.description: Exactly 64 Ed25519 signature bytes in canonical unpadded base64url after ed25519:. The independently pinned root original and strict signature verification remain mandatory.

path.description: Absolute nonroot visible-ASCII path with no backslash. Runtime additionally rejects empty, dot and dot-dot components, more than 64 components, or any component over 255 bytes. This scalar is not proof of filesystem identity, ownership or safe opening.

host.description: Signed launcher-host network association, not the future executable child's identity. Actual machine, boot, namespace and held-owner equality must be established separately.

isolation.description: Exact required future execution profile, not observations that a child has dropped IDs/groups/capabilities, entered namespaces or installed stdio. Namespace order is part of the signed contract.

resources.description: Signed cgroup/output ceilings only. Actual fixed-control writes, exact readback, whole-cgroup membership and bounded output custody are separate implementation obligations.

containment.description: A separately controlled new leaf under the pinned parent. The parent path and device/inode pair must both differ from the journal's. Naming this profile does not prove a guardian is armed or that a cgroup exists.

capability.description: Dedicated start capability and token commitment. Runtime must independently retain actual protected token bytes; the digest does not prove possession. Capability expiry bounds startBeforeEpochNs, not a renewal of proof or preparation time.

journal.description: Independent signed start-journal pins. The actual owner must protect, lock and durably claim the correct purpose; this object is neither an existing claim nor reset/retry authority.

sourceRevision.description: The source owner requires exact equality to its actual common SOURCE_REVISION; the pattern alone is not source compatibility.

payload.description: Runtime compares distinct egress/attachment grant digests and distinct creation/execution manifest digests. At one checked admission sample: issued <= wall < startBefore, startBefore-issued <= 300 seconds, startBefore <= capability expiry in nanoseconds, startBefore < stopAt with at most 86400 seconds between them, then 100 milliseconds <= cleanupBefore-stopAt <= 30 seconds. All four epochs are positive signed-64-bit nanoseconds. Exact original-clock continuity, cross-field equality, actual owner/resource joins and checked absolute boottime projections are not expressible as JSON shape or a reusable success DTO.
